properties.name: The loop says what DISTRIBUTION is owed, not only what coherence is owed
properties.statement: The loop reports that the live graph and the committed record disagree, alongside what coherence is owed. Filed by flo2 as F5 on 2026-08-09 — `loop_status` tracks what COHERENCE is owed and nothing tracks what DISTRIBUTION is owed — and observed here on 2026-08-10, where a record that had diverged from the graph sat on `main` for an unknown number of PRs while every gate reported green. THE SHAPE IS ALREADY DECIDED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-OPENED: `dec:read-hint-shape` chose state-derived, riding the orientation-shaped reads, firing only when the owed set changes. This requirement asks for distribution debt to be carried by that mechanism, not for a new one. DELIBERATELY LAST of the three steps in `dec:fix-the-comparison-before-pointing-it-earlier`: a hint that fires on phantom findings teaches the agent to skim it, which is the failure `dec:read-hint-shape` rejected its own option B for. This requirement's value is entirely downstream of the comparison deserving belief, so satisfying it before the first two steps would damage the mechanism it rides on.
